summary: Hand-built regex detectors for ~14 text properties were scored against sample labels to find an 8-property bundle perfectly collinear with topic. Corpus notes (properties nearly independent) were encoded; features @ probe gradient served as a logit proxy, calibrated against sample scores. Dependence ratios (cue effect / topic effect) came from two regressions, then from single-property programmatic edits of corpus notes. True-logit queries on hand-built pairs settled the ambiguous probes 0 and 1. A topic direction was re-estimated by regressing features on topic plus all properties. Latents were chosen greedily by same-sign cue contribution under a cumulative topic allowance, using topic-matched edit pairs, and checked offline on the queried pairs and with one sample ablation.

probe_query_use.purpose: true-logit dependence ratio for hashtag relative to topic

per_probe.procedure: Exclaim, bullet and case all fell in the 0.15-0.3 band in proxy estimates (paired edits, regressions). True logits on a hand-built running note with each property flipped alone gave exclaim ratio about -0.44 and bullet/case under 0.1, so exclaim was taken as the cue. Regex '!' matched the detector on all corpus notes. Latents: greedy by same-sign gradient x topic-matched edit delta, capped by cumulative clean-topic contribution (12%), 16 latents; removal checked offline on the queried pair.

Hashtag was the only bundle property clearly above the others (paired-edit ratio 0.31, true-logit pair 0.21, clean-topic regression 0.34); taken as cue because it stood out by about 3x over the next property. Regex '#'. Latents: greedy selection on topic-matched hashtag edit deltas with 12% topic allowance, 16 latents; capture near the 16-latent ceiling; removal checked offline on the queried pair.

per_probe.conclusion: he/him pronouns (male subject) and the phrase 'would you try'
per_probe.procedure: Every estimate put gender far above threshold (ratio >1) and 'would you try' near 0.4-0.5. Cross-section topic direction suggested gender latents damaged topic; regression-cleaned topic direction showed this was contamination. Regexes on pronouns and the phrase. Latents: 4 for gender by greedy selection (8% topic allowance), then 'would you try' latents added until the union reached 16. Sample ablation via probe_scores checked separation retained.

No bundle property reached 0.15 in paired-edit, fixed-effect or clean-topic estimates (max about 0.14 for gender). Argued that probe 3's proxy-to-score fraction was higher than probe 0's, so error-term amplification could not lift any property to the cue threshold; gender reconstructs well on probe 2, so its proxy ratio was taken as near-true.
per_probe.quote: Its overall reconstruction fraction (0.57) is *higher* than probe 0's (0.47), meaning *less* error-term amplification.

caveats: The session used shell subprocess calls and saved .npy paths; the script abstracts these into tool() return values. Exact selection constants changed several times (topic allowance 0.08-0.12, slot split for probe 2); intermediate plans are collapsed into one stage. The probe-1 hashtag call rested partly on a stated assumption of a clean gap between cue and non-cue strengths, encoded as a fixed decision. Detector set from the first pass is approximated. Probe-0 removal on the queried pair was low and attributed to an atypical base note; no further change resulted.
